pattern.name: precious_metal_sell
pattern.plain: Sell silver or gold that already closed green after the cutoff. XAGUSD, XAUUSD, and XAGEUR. A gold-euro buy is not this pattern.

refusal: No fresh set 1 or set 2 FIRE_SELL with emerged=0 on XAGUSD, XAUUSD, or XAGEUR. XAUUSD is not on the board. Silver set-1 S5 regime is UNDEFINED. Do not invent a fire and do not spray FX at 10 lots.
